scope.topicDefinition: One time-bounded atomic factual development; syndication stays together, material later developments stay separate.

sources.title: Eastport Opens Harbor Bridge
sources.factSummary: Eastport opened the Harbor Bridge to traffic on Monday after a five-year construction project.

sources.title: Eastport Opens Harbor Bridge
sources.factSummary: A syndicated copy reports Eastport opening the Harbor Bridge to traffic on Monday.

sources.title: Aster Observatory Begins Operations
sources.factSummary: The Aster Observatory began routine scientific operations after completing calibration.

sources.title: Aster Observatory Begins Operations
sources.factSummary: A wire copy reports that the Aster Observatory completed calibration and entered routine operations.

sources.title: Northport Starts Harbor Battery Pilot
sources.factSummary: Northport activated a six-month harbor battery pilot serving two municipal piers.

sources.title: Northport Starts Harbor Battery Pilot
sources.factSummary: A second URL variant describes activation of the same six-month harbor battery pilot.

sources.title: Central Library Releases Maritime Archive
sources.factSummary: Central Library released a digitized collection of nineteenth-century harbor records.

sources.title: Central Library Releases Maritime Archive
sources.factSummary: A licensed synthetic syndication copy reports release of the same digitized harbor-record collection.

sources.title: County Funds River Cleanup
sources.factSummary: The county approved a grant for removing waste from the Alder River during the summer.

sources.title: Summer Cleanup Funding Approved for Alder River
sources.factSummary: A local report describes the same county grant for summer waste removal from the Alder River.

sources.title: Metro Board Approves Fare Freeze
sources.factSummary: The Metro Board voted to keep standard fares unchanged for the next budget year.

sources.title: Transit Fares Will Stay Flat Next Year
sources.factSummary: A city report covers the same Metro Board vote to hold fares for the next budget year.

sources.title: North General Opens East Wing
sources.factSummary: North General Hospital opened a new east wing containing sixty inpatient rooms.

sources.title: New Hospital Wing Adds Sixty Rooms
sources.factSummary: A local report describes the opening of North General Hospital's sixty-room east wing.

sources.title: LunaLab Deploys Crater Sensor
sources.factSummary: LunaLab deployed its Polar-3 temperature sensor at the rim of Nansen crater.

sources.title: Polar-3 Sensor Now Operating at Nansen Crater
sources.factSummary: A space report covers the same deployment of LunaLab's Polar-3 sensor at Nansen crater.

sources.title: Eastport Opens Harbor Bridge
sources.factSummary: Despite the reused headline, this article concerns Eastport awarding a maintenance contract for an older bridge.

sources.title: Aster Observatory Begins Operations
sources.factSummary: Despite the reused headline, this article covers approval of next year's Aster Observatory operating budget.

sources.title: Northport Starts Harbor Battery Pilot
sources.factSummary: Despite the reused headline, Northport extended an already running battery pilot for another year.

sources.title: Central Library Releases Maritime Archive
sources.factSummary: Despite the reused headline, this report announces longer weekend opening hours at Central Library.

sources.title: County Funds River Cleanup
sources.factSummary: Despite the reused headline, the county announced fines for illegal dumping near the Alder River.

sources.title: Metro Board Approves Fare Freeze
sources.factSummary: Despite the reused headline, the Metro Board approved a station accessibility construction plan.

sources.title: North General Opens East Wing
sources.factSummary: Despite the reused headline, the hospital signed a new nursing staffing agreement.

sources.title: LunaLab Deploys Crater Sensor
sources.factSummary: Despite the reused headline, LunaLab released the sensor's first processed temperature dataset.

sources.title: New Harbor Bridge Closes After Sensor Alert
sources.factSummary: The newly opened Harbor Bridge was closed after a structural sensor issued an alert.

sources.title: Aster Observatory Publishes First-light Image
sources.factSummary: After operations began, the observatory published its first calibrated solar image and measurements.

sources.title: Northport Pauses Harbor Battery Pilot
sources.factSummary: Northport paused the battery pilot after overheating was detected at one pier.

sources.title: Library Suspends Maritime Archive Access
sources.factSummary: Central Library suspended access after discovering that several scans contained incorrect rights metadata.
